items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You know Ben? ... INTERVIEWEE: Yeah, I know Ben. Sure, I know Ben.

ctx.x: Alvin, Alvin. Related to Cullen. Well Alvin took his place in the band when he had to come back home. His wife was going to have a good boy to a child. Alvin came to medicine somewhere in Nebraska. That's another one. Benny. Another boy, Benny, he's dead. Benny Turner. Benny Turner's not dead at all. You know Ben? He's a pianist? He's over and out there. Oh no, I know. Not a band. Yeah, I know. He's a dog, dog, prostitute. Yeah, I know Ben. Sure, I know Ben.
Is he a pianist too? Yeah, he's a pianist.
